message1: Mere life ka sabse beautiful part tum ho. Jab bhi tum mere paas hoti ho, mujhe aisa lagta hai sab kuch perfect hai.
message2: Tumhari wo choti choti baatein, humara sath hasna, aur bina kuch kahe ek dusre ko samajhna—ye sab mere liye sabse special hai.
message3: I love you so much. Har din tumhare sath bitana mere liye ek blessing ki tarah hai. Tum humesha meri rehna.
